documents.title: INC-4402 Lithography stepper focus drift
documents.text:
INC-4402 Lithography stepper focus drift
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 2 July. Critical dimensions on 14 wafers drifted outside tolerance during the night shift. Cause: a stepper focus sensor contaminated by resist vapour. The sensor window was cleaned and an extra focus check added per lot.

documents.title: INC-4408 Lithography resist coater nozzle clog
documents.text:
INC-4408 Lithography resist coater nozzle clog
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 5 July. Resist thickness maps showed streaks on a full cassette. Cause: a partly clogged coater nozzle after an idle weekend. Nozzle purges now run before the first lot of every shift.

documents.title: INC-4415 Etch chamber endpoint miss
documents.text:
INC-4415 Etch chamber endpoint miss
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 9 July. The plasma etch overshot on six wafers because the optical endpoint was never detected. Cause: a fogged endpoint viewport. The viewport was replaced and its transmission is logged daily.

documents.title: INC-4419 Etch helium backside leak
documents.text:
INC-4419 Etch helium backside leak
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 11 July. Wafer temperature rose during etch and the tool aborted mid-recipe. Cause: a worn chuck seal letting backside helium leak. The seal was replaced and a leak-rate check added to the weekly list.

documents.title: INC-4427 Deposition film stress out of range
documents.text:
INC-4427 Deposition film stress out of range
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 16 July. Nitride films came out with compressive stress twice the specification. Cause: a mass flow controller reading low on ammonia. The controller was recalibrated and cross-checked against a reference.

documents.title: INC-4433 Deposition particle burst
documents.text:
INC-4433 Deposition particle burst
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Fab bay F, 20 July. A particle burst covered one lot after a chamber clean. Cause: flakes from an over-due shield kit. Shield kits are now swapped on a fixed wafer count.
